An original game set in real Chennai.
Map: {0}{1}, ODbL 1.0. Building heights, colours and road widths are estimated where OpenStreetMap has none.
The Tamil text in this game is still being checked by Tamil speakers, so some lines may read oddly.

You change into the {0}. Your mother says it needs ironing.
The escalator is jammed with families taking a group photo on every step. Ten minutes to go up one floor.
Two rival coffee-stall owners on the same street fall in love during a week of monsoon rain.
A song in the rain, under one shared umbrella with a hole in it.
They argue over chicory for ten full minutes, then hold hands.
A soft-spoken bus conductor stands up to the gang that hoards the neighbourhood's water tankers.
The conductor stops a runaway tanker with one punch-ticket.
Slow-motion walk through a water-pipe shower, three times.
Three generations of one family fight over the last vada at a cousin's wedding lunch.
Grandfather hides the vada inside his turban.
The bride's uncle starts a sambar-tasting contest that nobody asked for.
BUY 1 GET 1*: your free item is a pair of socks (*see small print).
The free item is socks again; you already have socks.
A day pass is ₹{0}. The trainer suggests push-ups at home.
The doctor checks you over: perfectly healthy. The nurse gives you a lollipop anyway.
The credits roll and half the hall is already outside, discussing the climax.
The hero's entry: the whole hall whistles, and paper confetti rains from the back rows.
INTERVAL. Everyone rushes the snack counter at once, as if the popcorn might run out.
Someone's phone rings, loudly. He answers: "I'm in the theatre, the hero just came. Call me at the interval."
No money for popcorn. Your neighbour offers you one piece.
You are not ill. The man behind you in the queue asks if you will give him your token.
You buy the {0} and wear it out of the shop. {1}
Popcorn, ₹{0}. By the time you are back, your neighbour has eaten a third of it.
Three hours, one token number and four new friends in the queue later, you are treated for free.
{0} of {1} good reps. The trainer says you lifted more selfies than weights. Not counted.
{0} of {1} good reps. You already trained today: rest days build muscle too. Come back tomorrow.
{0} of {1} good reps. Already at top fitness: the trainer asks you to demonstrate for the new joiners.
{0} of {1} good reps. Fitness {2}/{3}: sprinting is {4}% faster.
You sleep until {0}. The neighbour's pressure cooker whistles you awake, fully rested. Game saved.
You came in with the ambulance, so the staff treat you free. A bandage, a tetanus shot and a lecture about helmets.
Treatment costs ₹{0} and you have ₹{1}. The free counter is always open, if you can wait.
Bandaged and patched up for ₹{0}. The doctor writes "rest" on the prescription in very large letters.
You wait in the lobby for the {0} show.
You walk in just as the {0} show starts.

Chennai Central railway station opened in 1873.
Change the time of day or the weather from PAUSE or SETTINGS.
Marina Beach is one of the longest urban beaches in the world.
Free roam: the city is yours.
Every stage is complete. The city is yours.
Everyday work around the city. Failing a job costs a fine and reputation, never the game. Reputation {0}.

Touch controls on foot and driving
Time of day, weather and sound
It ran at {0} fps. Change it in Settings → Graphics.
The load is shaking: smooth and slow
Stretch your legs. Walk down the street to the marker.
Your cousin left his hatchback on the street. Take it across town to Kilpauk Garden Road.
Drive to Kilpauk Garden Road, Kilpauk
Cover a friend's auto in Perambur for one fare. Pick the passenger up and drop them in Amirthammal Colony before they lose patience.
Three parcels, three addresses between Chetpet and Nungambakkam, and the clock is running on each one.
Deliver parcel 1 of 3, Mc Nichols Road
Deliver parcel 3 of 3, Spur Tank Road
Corner to corner across Anna Nagar, as fast as the streets allow.
Lunch boxes go cold fast. Take the motorbike and make both drops on time.
Collect the lunch boxes, Jeenis Road, Saidapet
Three thugs are shaking down walkers in Tower Park. No weapons, just fists. Sort them out.
A stolen motorbike is being stripped on a back street off Jawaharlal Nehru Road in Vadapalani, and two of the gang are armed. You have a pistol now: FIRE shoots where you look.
Find the thieves, off Jawaharlal Nehru Road
Ride it back to its owner on Arcot Road
The gang keeps its takings in a godown in the Ambattur Industrial Estate, far across town. Four guards, all armed. Use the corners.
Get to the godown, Ambit Park Road, Ambattur
The boss is waiting at the Roundtana with his best men. End it.
Defeat the boss and his men
With the boss gone, three gangs want his streets. The Manjal Puli (Yellow Tigers) send a rider down Peters Road in Royapettah with the week's protection money. Take a car and stop him.
Wait on Peters Road for the courier
Catch the courier: pull up beside him
Take the money back to the tea shop, Triplicane High Road

A tea shop owner in the Flower Bazaar paid the Manjal Puli for years. Now the Neela Nandu (Blue Crabs) want a cut too, and four of them are walking up the street. Stand with him. He keeps an old shotgun under the counter for you.
Wait at the tea shop, Audiappa Naicken Street
Word is out that you took the Neela Nandu's money. A friend left you a motorbike on KMS Street; the crew is waiting by it. Get on and ride for the Marina beach road.
Ride to the beach road before they get you
The Pachai Paambu (Green Snakes) of Egmore have been arming both sides. Their hideout is a back street off Pantheon Road. Six of them, with shotguns and an SMG. Clear it out.
The Manjal Puli boss has called every crew he has left to the bus junction in T. Nagar to finish this. So have you.
Go to the bus junction, T. Nagar
Match day at Chepauk. A kitchen near Egmore station has forty parcels of biryani for the dressing room and its delivery rider has flu. The toss is soon: ride, and don't stop for tea.
Collect the biryani near Egmore station
Deliver it to the stadium gate, Wallajah Road
Last box to the scorers, Victoria Hostel Road

Selvi akka's niece gets married in Mylapore this morning and the hired van never came. Three of the family are waiting on Westcott Road in their silks. Take the auto by the clock tower and get them to the mandapam before the muhurtham.
Get in the auto by the clock tower
Pick up the wedding party on Westcott Road
Get them to the mandapam on North Mada Street, Mylapore

Lakshmi, who sells jasmine by the temple near Elliot's Beach, wants a word. As she talks, someone slips a gold chain into your pocket and a constable starts shouting. Lose the police, then hand the chain in at the temple office.
Meet Lakshmi at her flower stall, Besant Nagar 2nd Avenue
Someone planted a stolen chain on you: lose the police
Hand the chain in at the temple office, Besant Nagar

Padma Raghavan, a Carnatic singer with a concert in Mumbai tomorrow, has missed her ride and her train leaves Central soon. A car is parked on North Mada Street. Pick her up on South Mada Street and get her to Chennai Central.
Get in the car on North Mada Street
Pick up the singer on South Mada Street
Drop her at Chennai Central, EVR Periyar Salai
A gang is robbing delivery riders on the beach road at Santhome. Five of them, bats and fists. Police patrols are thick on the beach road, so leave the guns holstered and settle it by hand.
Go to Kamarajar Salai, the beach road at Santhome
Beat the gang robbing the riders

Padma's accompanist sent her harmonium ahead on a suburban train, and a thief has taken it off at Egmore. Walk to Park station, take the train one stop to Egmore, then catch him on the motorbike outside the station.
Take a train from Park to Chennai Egmore (BOARD on the platform)
Step off and get on the motorbike outside Egmore station
Catch the thief on EVR Periyar Salai
Bring the harmonium back to Egmore station
A patient needs a hospital now. Use the SIREN to clear the traffic, and drive smoothly: every bump hurts.
Drive the patient to the hospital
Collect a parcel from the post office and get it across town on the motorbike. No damage earns a bonus.
Collect the parcel at the post office on 8th Street
A passenger is waiting for a car. The fare goes by distance; a smooth ride earns a tip.
Drop the passenger on 4th Avenue (Santhi Colony Road)
Drive the city bus round its loop. Stop at every stop in order and keep to the timetable.
Bus stop 1 of 4 on 4th Avenue (Santhi Colony Road)
Bus stop 2 of 4 on 4th Avenue (Santhi Colony Road)
Bus stop 3 of 4 on 4th Avenue (Santhi Colony Road)
Bus stop 4 of 4 on 4th Avenue (Santhi Colony Road)
A stable patient needs moving between hospitals for a scan. Less rush, but a smooth ride matters even more.
Collect the patient at the hospital on 6th Main Road
Three hot lunches from one kitchen to three homes. Ride fast, ride clean.
Collect the orders on 2nd Avenue, Anna Nagar West
A hospital ward has run short. Take a box of medicine from the chemist, quickly.
Collect the medicine on 1st Main Road

Run a share auto down 2nd Avenue, Thirumangalam to Anna Nagar East. People wave it down anywhere: pull up beside them to let them in (4 seats), and stop where each one asks to get off. Fares are small (about ₹10 plus ₹5 a km each, estimated); missing a drop or passing people by costs reputation.
End of the route at Anna Nagar East
A visitor wants to see Anna Nagar Tower Park before it closes. Take them to the gate.
Pick up the visitor on 2nd Avenue, Anna Nagar West
Drop them at Anna Nagar Tower Park
The same loop backwards at the busy hour. Tighter timetable, more people waiting.
Bus stop 1 of 4 on 4th Avenue (Santhi Colony Road)
Bus stop 2 of 4 on 4th Avenue (Santhi Colony Road)
Bus stop 3 of 4 on 4th Avenue (Santhi Colony Road)
Bus stop 4 of 4 on 4th Avenue (Santhi Colony Road)
Take a friend from T. Nagar to Marina Beach for the evening breeze. Anna Salai is jammed at this hour: cross it, don't drive along it. Evenings only (16:00–20:30); the clock starts at the pick-up.
Pick up your friend on Sir Thyagaraya Road, T. Nagar
Drop them at Marina Beach, on the beach road
A stable patient moves from a hospital in Egmore to one in Royapettah for treatment, through central Chennai. Use the SIREN; three bumps end the run.
Collect the patient at the hospital on Pantheon Road, Egmore
Transfer to the hospital on Conron Smith Road, Royapettah
Drive the bus up Anna Salai from Teynampet towards Thousand Lights, stopping at four real stops in order. Keep to the timetable in the heaviest traffic in town.
Your grandmother has a check-up at Sugam Hospital and has been ready since six in the morning. Drive her there, and home again before her TV serial starts.
Paati gives you ₹400 and the rest of her tiffin. The doctor's advice for you: fewer vadas.
Get in a car: Paati is waiting
Drive Paati to Sugam Hospital. Gently: she is holding a tiffin box
Walk Paati in for her check-up (ENTER Sugam Hospital)
Drive Paati home before her serial starts
Your friend Selva bets you can't match his four good reps, then beat him to the juice shop on foot. Loser buys the sugarcane juice.
Selva pays for the juice and the bet, and books a rematch for next week.
Match Selva: 4 good reps out of 5 (in the gym)
Race Selva to the juice shop, on foot
Ravi got two tickets for the first show of a new film at Minnal Cinemas. Pick him up on the motorbike and get there before the hero's entry.
Ravi pays you back for the petrol. He has already booked the second show.
Get on a motorbike: the show starts soon
Pick up Ravi (he is still choosing a shirt)
Ride to Minnal Cinemas before the hero's entry
Go in for the first show (ENTER Minnal Cinemas)

A student's entrance exam starts at nine and the gates shut on the stroke. The lodge to the exam centre on Greams Road is across the city at rush hour. Get there on time, and if the gate has shut, the side gate on Pathari Road stays open for a few minutes more.
Reach the gate with 2 minutes to spare
No horn in the hospital zone
Get in the auto outside the lodge
Pick up the student at the lodge
Drive to the exam centre gate, Greams Road
The gate has shut: run to the side gate, Pathari Road

Sixty guests, one wedding hall, and a vessel of sambar that must arrive hot and not half-spilled. The lane through the back streets is short and rough; the main road is smooth and long. Watch the stability meter: every breaker and pothole takes some.
Arrive with the vessel over 90% intact
Get in the goods auto behind the caterer's
Load the sambar vessel at the caterer's kitchen
Deliver the vessel to the wedding hall, Venkatakrishna Road

A call to the wrong number, and a stranger's voice sounding afraid: a parcel runner is carrying something that is not his, and he keeps changing scooters. Follow him down Mount Road without being noticed, then decide what to do with what you learn.
Wait at the junction on Mount Road where the runner appears
Follow the parcel runner to the drop-off, unseen
He swaps scooters in a side lane
He swaps scooters in a side lane
He swaps scooters in a side lane
He has dropped the envelope. What now?
Report it to the police station
More money, and a star of police heat. Something later reacts.
Take it to the police station, Nandanam Main Road

The northeast monsoon has broken over the coast and a patient needs the hospital in Alwarpet. The shortest road floods first; the minimap shows the water. Re-route early and drive smoothly: the patient feels every jolt.
Pick up the patient on Santhome High Road
Take the patient to the hospital, TTK Road

A general strike has shut the main roads and every shop. Three urgent deliveries must still cross the city before noon, and the only doors open are the back ones. Use the lanes and the beach road; the shut roads show red on the minimap.
The envelope's owners know your bike now. Keep clear of the police.
Get on the motorbike behind the depot
Collect the three urgent parcels at the depot's back door, Pantheon Road
Back door 1, Bharathi Salai: the medicine
Back door 2, Buchi Babu Street: the lunch box
Back door 3, the beach road: the parcel
